let split := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 5 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%4=1); (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0<s.re → s.re<1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s=0 → s.re=1/2)→
∃ b C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ z : ℕ, 5≤z →
  |(∑ p ∈ split z, (1 : ℝ)/(p : ℝ)) - Real.log (Real.log z)/2 - b| ≤
    C * (Real.log (2*(z : ℝ)))^2 / Real.sqrt z

brief.en: Use QP-0005 and QP-0006 to pass from ψ to the true prime sum θ. Sum by parts with 1/(t log t). The frozen type retains the zero-line assumption used for the explicit formula.
